sources.name: Timezone Australia venue locator
sources.example_data_quote: Haymarket: Level 3 Market City, 9-13 Hay Street, Haymarket, Sydney, NSW, 2000. Tags: Games, Parties, Pixel, Prizes, Billiards. Page claims 150+ arcade games; does NOT name maimai/chunithm/taiko per venue. Brand games page lists Mai Mai, Taiko No Tatsujin, DDR A, Pop'n Music as product types with note 'Games at selected venues. Games vary by venue.'
sources.adds_over_current: Stable official address/hours for ~70 AU FECs with clean /en-au/venues/{state}/timezone-{slug}/ pattern. Does NOT add per-venue music-game lineups. Map already has many Timezone rows from ALL.Net+ZIv (e.g. TIMEZONE(HAYMARKET) already has chunithm/ddr/drs/gitadora/maimai_dx/popn/pump_it_up/sdvx/taiko). Useful for reconciling missing/other-only TZ stubs (Fountain Gate, Charlestown, Mandurah, Baldivis, etc.) with current open status and address only.
sources.note: TEEG brand. Same family as Zone Bowling/Kingpin. Not a cab-list wiki. Disney Photobooth section is one of few places listing specific venue names for a named product.

sources.name: Timezone New Zealand venue locator
sources.example_data_quote: Timezone Newmarket: 135-151 Broadway, Newmarket, Auckland, 1023. Activities: Laser Tag, Parties, Prizes, Games. No named rhythm cabinets on venue page. Live list includes Queen St, Bayfair, Botany, Courtenay Place, Napier, Newmarket, Palmerston Square, The Base Hamilton, Victoria Street Hamilton, Whangarei, Rotorua Central, Christchurch Central, Dunedin, Nelson, Riccarton.
sources.adds_over_current: Authoritative NZ chain roster (~15 venues) with addresses. Map already has most via ALL.Net+ZIv (e.g. TIMEZONE NEW MARKET has ddr/maimai_dx/pump_it_up/taiko). Official site still does not publish per-venue music-game lists; maimai presence for select NZ stores is better proven by ALL.Net and social/press than by this locator.
sources.note: NZ brand games marketing mentions Mai Mai and Taiko No Tatsujin generically; venue pages only say 'arcade games'.

sources.name: Archie Brothers Cirque Electriq locations
sources.example_data_quote: Glen Waverley: Century City, 285 Springvale Rd, Glen Waverley VIC 3150. Perth, Castle Towers, Point Cook, Alexandria, Karrinyup, Rundle Place, Wollongong, Entertainment Quarter, Fremantle, Melbourne Docklands, Chatswood, QV Melbourne, Surfers Paradise, Sunshine Coast, Penrith, Moorabbin, Chadstone, Bowen Hills listed with full addresses and activity icons (arcade/bowling/etc), not music game names.
sources.adds_over_current: Complete Funlab/Archie Brothers AU roster and addresses under /locations/{slug}. Does not list maimai/taiko/DDR. Map already has ~19 Archie rows; several are partial (e.g. Entertainment Quarter is other-only on map; Glen Waverley/CCW has ddr+maimai_dx+taiko from ALL.Net). Locator helps fill missing venues or address corrections, not cab lineups.
sources.note: Funlab family brand. NZ Archie venues appear in map (Christchurch, Wellington, Newmarket) but were not verified on this AU domain locator today.

sources.name: iPlay Australia locations
sources.example_data_quote: Listing page: Showing 29 results across QLD/NSW/VIC/ACT/WA/NT. Per venue shows suburb/centre and experience icons (arcade, bowling, laser, pixel, etc). Lidcombe Tenpin City, Carousel, Belconnen, Wetherill Park, Redbank, Whitfords, etc. No cabinet-level music game inventory on location pages.
sources.adds_over_current: Official multi-state FEC chain (~29 including coming-soon). Several map iPlay rows are other-only (Redbank, Eastern Creek, Whitfords, Coffs Harbour). Locator confirms they exist and are branded arcade venues, but does not supply rhythm/music game names. Music coverage on map still depends on ALL.Net/ZIv (e.g. IPLAY CAROUSEL has ddr/maimai_dx/taiko; iPlay Tenpin City Lidcombe has maimai_dx/taiko).
sources.note: Family-owned chain separate from TEEG Timezone. Good for completeness of AU FEC coverage, weak for rhythm cab detail.

sources.name: Kingpin Play venues (AU/NZ)
sources.example_data_quote: 10 venues: Macarthur, North Strathfield, Crown, Melbourne Collins St, Canberra, Chermside, Townsville, Norwood, Darwin, Queenstown NZ. Per venue: activity tags (Bowling, Arcade Games, Darts, Karaoke, Laser Tag...) not specific music titles.
sources.adds_over_current: Official TEEG Kingpin roster including NZ Queenstown. Map already has most with partial music tags from ALL.Net/ZIv (KINGPIN MELBOURNE has chunithm/ddr/drs/maimai_dx/taiko; Kingpin Darwin is other-only). Site does not add missing music games; confirms venue set and addresses.
sources.note: Sibling brand to Timezone under TEEG. Same limitation: no per-venue cab lists.

sources.name: Koko Amusement (Sydney multi-site operator)
sources.example_data_quote: Home contact block: George St (Town Hall) Koko, 614 George Street Sydney NSW 2000, Mon-Fri 10am-2am; George St (Cityheroes) 505 George Street; Belmore St (Burwood) Level 3 Emerald Square 27-31 Belmore St; Hornsby Westfield called out as open. Games page https://www.kokoamusement.com.au/games lists redemption/skill titles plus Dance Dance Revolution ACE and Midnight Maximum Tune 6; does NOT list maimai/chunithm/iidx despite community reports of heavy rhythm floors at Town Hall.
sources.adds_over_current: Operator site for Sydney's densest rhythm destination brand. Map already has strong ALL.Net+ZIv coverage for major sites (KOKO AMUSEMENT 614: chunithm/ddr/drs/gitadora/iidx/maimai_dx/popn/pump_it_up/sdvx/taiko; City Heroes and Burwood also tagged). Site games page is incomplete vs reality and does not beat ALL.Net for music games. Still useful for hours/addresses and confirming Hornsby/Burwood/Town Hall/City Heroes as live multi-site operator. Some Koko map stubs remain other-only (Bankstown, Chatswood, Koko Amusement 591).
sources.note: Wix site; not a structured multi-venue cab database. Community YouTube/Discord describe more rhythm cabs than the official games page admits.

sources.name: 1UP Arcade Brisbane full game list
sources.example_data_quote: Single venue: Ground-Floor of LASER FORCE in Woolloongabba. Claims ~140 original arcade games with constantly updated A-Z list (1942, Alien vs Predator, Bubble Bobble, Daytona USA Championship, Dariusburst AC, Golden Axe, Guilty Gear, etc). Retro/fighting/shmup focus, not modern SEGA/Konami network music games.
sources.adds_over_current: Best structured per-cab inventory found in region, but only one venue and almost no modern rhythm network titles. Not observed as a separate named entry under 1UP in arcades.json sample search (may be absent or nested under another name). Would help a retro/other-only venue if added; does not solve AU/NZ music-game Other-only problem at scale.
sources.note: Excellent single-site retro database; wrong shape for region-wide music-arcade enrichment.

summary: Searched for AU/NZ equivalents of hkarcade.fandom.com (structured multi-venue cab databases). Result: no live dedicated regional wiki/spreadsheet/community map with venue-level music cabinets was verified. Rhythm coverage for Oceania is already largely driven by ALL.Net (maimai etc.) + ZIv stubs; the 91 other-only venues are mostly FECs/bars/cinemas without public cab lists. What exists and is live today: official locators for Timezone AU (~70), Timezone NZ (~15), Archie Brothers (~19), iPlay (~29), Kingpin (~10 AU+NZ), plus Koko Amusement operator site (Sydney multi-site) and 1UP Brisbane single-venue retro list. All chain locators give addresses/hours/activity icons; none publish per-venue maimai/chunithm/SDVX/IIDX inventories. Compared three map examples: TIMEZONE(HAYMARKET) and KOKO AMUSEMENT 614 already have rich ALL.Net music tags that official sites do not improve; TIMEZONE NEW MARKET similarly already tagged; other-only stubs like Timezone Fountain Gate / Charlestown / Mandurah / Koko Bankstown gain only open-status/address confirmation from operators, not games. Community signals (maimaiAUS Discord ~4k members, YouTube venue tours, Yeah Nah Gaming NZ press) are real but not scrapable structured sources. Honest takeaway: Oceania has strong commercial FEC locators, not a hidden cab-list wiki. Enriching other-only rows needs operator visits, Discord ethnography, or ALL.Net/e-amusement refresh rather than a new scrapeable regional DB.
dead_ends: ZIv already in pipeline (not a new find). ALL.Net location.am-all.net already in pipeline. aussiearcade.com 'Arcade Game Location Database' topic (2005-era forum thread) returned Cloudflare challenge; not verified as current multi-venue data. intencity.com.au/locations blocked by Cloudflare today (unverified). arcadelocations.net Australia search failed to load. arcadepreservation.fandom.com has sparse/historical Intencity AU pages, not a maintained live cab database. maimaiAUS Discord is the main community hub but is not a public structured venue DB. Yeah Nah Gaming NZ articles are one-off venue press (e.g. Rotorua Timezone game names) not a systematic map. Museum of the Game / arcade-museum.com map is global retro and US-heavy, not AU music FECs. Google Maps/Yelp/TripAdvisor excluded as data sources per brief. No NZ-only cab wiki found.
